content.summary: Selected pragmatic feature-complete path based on upstream PR research

data.decision: Adopt opencode#12188 route/component architecture patterns, but avoid opentui#621 dependency and source diffs from project git staged+unstaged changes
data.rationale: This keeps fork conflicts minimal, preserves required UX outcomes, and avoids high maintenance risk from open opentui core changes while satisfying the user requirement of project-scoped git changes independent of session diff.
